item.title: Hear how to join a pottery studio
item.summary: A manager separates beginner classes from open practice.
item.transcript_text: New members often ask whether they can come to open studio right away. Please take one beginner class first, even if you have worked with clay at home. We need to show you how to clean the tools here. The class is on Tuesday from seven to eight. The studio provides clay and tools, but please bring an old shirt. After the class you can book a table for open studio online.

questions.explanation: The first sentence identifies new members.
One class is the required first step.

questions.prompt: Why teach people with some experience?
options: To teach the studio’s way of cleaning tools
questions.explanation: The speaker names learning to clean tools.
The studio supplies clay and tools.

questions.prompt: How can a learner arrange open studio afterward?
questions.explanation: The final sentence explains online booking.
